result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it so that no one ever has to choose between survival and dignity.

That means ending poverty and hunger as we know them — not through charity, but through systems that guarantee every person access to food, shelter, healthcare, and meaningful work. Because most of the cruelty in the world, I think, is downstream of desperation. If people could feel secure, they’d have more space to be kind.

That would be my one change.
